_description: Published D-A gating parameters from MD/QM-MM simulations in the PCET literature.

_fields.M_DA: Effective D-A oscillator mass in amu
_fields.method: How gating params were obtained (MD, QM/MM, fitted)

SLO-1.description: Soybean lipoxygenase-1 wild type, C-H abstraction by Fe(III)-OH
SLO-1.reference: Hatcher et al. JACS 126, 5763 (2004); Edwards et al. JPC B 116, 11876 (2012)
SLO-1.notes: Most well-studied PCET gating system. Ω and M from classical MD of enzyme.

SLO-1-L546A.description: SLO-1 L546A mutant, enlarged active-site cavity
SLO-1-L546A.notes: Gating freq estimated from T-dependent KIE fitting. Looser cavity → lower Ω.

SLO-1-DM.reference: Hu et al. JACS 136, 8157 (2014); Meyer et al. PNAS 105, 1146 (2008)
SLO-1-DM.notes: Record KIE. Significantly rigidified and elongated D-A.

AADH.description: Aromatic amine dehydrogenase, tryptamine C-H cleavage
AADH.reference: Masgrau et al. Science 312, 237 (2006); Hay & Scrutton PCCP 14, 13523 (2012)
AADH.notes: Ω and M fitted to T-dependent KIE data by Scrutton/Hay group.

MADH.reference: Basran et al. JBC 278, 43973 (2003); Hay et al. Nat Chem 4, 161 (2012)
MADH.notes: Similar to AADH but stiffer active site.

TMADH.reference: Scrutton et al. JBC 269, 13502 (1994); Hay & Scrutton PCCP 14, 13523 (2012)
TMADH.notes: Stiffest of the amine dehydrogenases, small KIE.

DHFR-EcDHFR.description: E. coli dihydrofolate reductase, NADPH hydride transfer
DHFR-EcDHFR.reference: Agarwal et al. JACS 124, 13816 (2002); Hammes-Schiffer Acc Chem Res 39, 93 (2006)
DHFR-EcDHFR.notes: Well-studied hydride transfer. Nearly adiabatic. Stiff NAD+ binding pocket.

LADH.description: Liver alcohol dehydrogenase, NAD+ hydride transfer
LADH.reference: Bahnson et al. Biochemistry 32, 5503 (1993); Kohen & Klinman Chem Biol 6, R191 (1999)
LADH.notes: Zn-dependent. Gating Ω estimated from Arrhenius prefactor analysis.

PHM.reference: Francisco et al. Biochemistry 41, 6573 (2002); Edwards et al. JPC A 113, 2117 (2009)
PHM.notes: Copper enzyme, very short D-A distance, stiff.

RNR-Y356-Y731.description: Ribonucleotide reductase, tyrosine radical PCET relay
RNR-Y356-Y731.reference: Soudackov et al. JPC B 116, 12966 (2012); Hammes-Schiffer JACS 137, 8860 (2015)
RNR-Y356-Y731.notes: Long-range PCET. Tyr-O to Tyr-O transfer across protein interface.

RNR-C439.description: Ribonucleotide reductase, thiyl radical C-H abstraction
RNR-C439.reference: Stubbe & Nocera Chem Rev 103, 2167 (2003); Hammes-Schiffer JACS 131, 2385 (2009)
RNR-C439.notes: S-H bond cleavage step. Heavier S atom increases M_DA.

TSase.reference: Agrawal et al. Biochemistry 43, 10295 (2004); Kohen & Klinman JACS 122, 10738 (2000)
TSase.notes: Hydride transfer from CH2H4folate. Gating from T-dependent KIE.

GO.notes: Cu(II)/Tyr-radical. Gating Ω estimated from KIE temperature dependence.

TauD.reference: Krebs & Bollinger Biochemistry 46, 10413 (2007); Srnec et al. JACS 139, 18166 (2017)
TauD.notes: FeIV=O intermediate. Heavy Fe-oxo oscillator gives large M_DA.

P450-CYP101.reference: Shaik et al. Chem Rev 110, 949 (2010); Olsson et al. JACS 126, 2820 (2004)
P450-CYP101.notes: Compound I (FeIV=O por+·). Similar gating to TauD.
